meta_state_law_citations_007.answer: When a teacher is absent due to injury (incurred during the course of employment or related thereto), the unpaid difference between benefits paid under the Workers' Compensation Act of New Mexico and the teacher's regular pay shall be paid by the District from accrued sick leave benefits.
